# Project quotation builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/quotation-builder/

Create a client quote with line items, terms, expiry date and PDF output. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Quote design and development line items with an expiry date and editable payment terms.

## Limits and checks

A quotation is a proposed scope and price. Review the document and agree terms separately before treating it as a contract.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
